title: GPT-5.3 Chat & GPT-5.4 Reasoning are retiring from Copilot Studio and agents will be migrated to newer supported models
body:
We are announcing the end of support for selected AI models on the Standard harnesses in Copilot Studio. Beginning on October 15, 2026, the selected models will no longer be available in Copilot Studio, and agents will automatically migrate to a replacement model.

How does this affect me?

Agents configured with retiring models will be automatically migrated to a supported replacement model. The planned replacement model and migration date depends on both the model and the harness used by the agent. 

Review your agents by harness and model to identify those using a retiring model, then work with their owners to prepare for migration.

For the latest model availability, see the guidance for your agent’s harness in Standard harness model availability.

GPT Chat Latest is the supported chat model option going forward for the Copilot Studio Standard harness. It keeps agents on the latest supported GPT chat model. Moving to a new model version is a separate change, and customers will receive at least 30 days' notice.

Choose the model that best fits your agent

You can use the planned replacement or choose another supported model that better meets your agent’s quality, performance, or cost needs.

Model availability depends on your harness, region, and administrator settings. Use the guidance for your agent’s harness:
- Standard harness 
Test your agent on the model you choose before migration begins.

What action do I need to take? 

Before the migration date for each retiring model, we recommend admins and makers take the following actions:
- Identify affected agents in the Power Platform admin center by going to Manage > Copilot Studio and reviewing agents by harness and model.
- The model field is currently in preview. The inventory reflects published agent configurations, so unpublished model changes might not appear. See the admin agent inventory for details. 
- Notify the appropriate agent owners.
- Test the planned replacement model, or choose another supported model that better meets quality, performance, or cost requirements.
- Validate response accuracy, key workflows, tool and action execution, and business-critical integrations.
- Adjust agent instructions or configuration if testing identifies behavior changes.
- Review model availability, regional availability, and any cross-geo or external model-provider requirements.
For more information, please visit: 
- Test your agent
- Copilot Studio model lifecycle guidance
- Copilot Studio agent inventory
- Chat Latest Model | OpenAI API
